definition_en: The ability to create user-centred designs for products, interfaces, or services, ensuring usability, accessibility, and aesthetic quality.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk menghasilkan reka bentuk berpusatkan pengguna bagi produk, antara muka atau perkhidmatan, memastikan kebolehgunaan, kebolehaksesan dan kualiti estetik.
typical_tasks_en:
• Redesign the clinic appointment booking page to reduce confusion for elderly users.
• Prototype a mobile checkout flow and test it with five customers.
• Choose colour contrasts that meet accessibility guidelines for the new app.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Reka bentuk semula halaman tempahan janji temu klinik untuk mengurangkan kekeliruan warga emas.
• Prototaip aliran daftar keluar mudah alih dan uji dengan lima pelanggan.
• Pilih kontras warna yang memenuhi garis panduan kebolehcapaian untuk aplikasi baharu.
inclusion_rules:
• The task involves creating visual or interactive designs
• The task requires researching user needs and behaviours
• The task involves prototyping or wireframing interfaces
• The task requires conducting usability testing
• The task involves improving accessibility or user satisfaction
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only implementing designs created by others
• The user makes arbitrary visual choices without user research
• The task requires no consideration of end-user needs
• The user is only doing graphic decoration without UX intent
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task implements someone else's design or decorates without user research or usability intent.

confusions.boundary_rule: Design applies creativity to user problems. Creative thinking is broader idea generation.
confusions.example_task: Design a creative yet usable interface for the new app.
confusions.expected_labels: Creative thinking; Design and user experience

confusions.boundary_rule: Design is about user experience. Marketing is about promotion and reach.
confusions.example_task: Create a landing page that is both visually appealing and converts visitors.
confusions.expected_labels: Design and user experience; Marketing and media

confusions.boundary_rule: Design defines the user interface. Programming implements it.
confusions.example_task: Design the checkout flow and then work with developers to build it.

examples.task_text: Redesign the clinic appointment booking page to reduce confusion for elderly users.
Prototype a mobile checkout flow and test it with five customers.
Implement a UI exactly as provided by the designer.
examples.reason: Implementation without design or UX work.
